headline.title: Anthropic created a test marketplace for agent-on-agent commerce
headline.summary: Anthropic has developed a classified marketplace where AI agents act as both buyers and sellers, successfully completing transactions for actual goods and money. This experiment aims to explore the dynamics of agent-on-agent commerce in AI systems.

articles.title: Maine’s governor vetoes data center moratorium
articles.summary: Maine's governor has vetoed L.D. 307, which aimed to establish the nation's first statewide moratorium on new data centers until November 1, 2027. The veto prevents the proposed halt on the development of data centers in the state.

articles.title: Why Tokyo is the most important tech destination of 2026
articles.summary: Tokyo will host SusHi Tech 2026, focusing on four key technology domains with live demonstrations and dedicated exhibit floors. The event aims to showcase innovations and discussions led by industry leaders and investors in the global tech landscape.

articles.title: Apple under Ternus: what comes next for the tech giant’s hardware strategy
articles.summary: John Ternus, Apple's new CEO, is expected to refocus the company's strategy on hardware development, emphasizing the importance of devices in Apple's future plans. This shift suggests a potential change in direction for the tech giant as it prioritizes its hardware offerings.

articles.title: OpenAI CEO apologizes to Tumbler Ridge community
articles.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman issued an apology to the residents of Tumbler Ridge, Canada, for the company's failure to notify law enforcement about a suspect involved in a recent mass shooting. The apology was communicated through a letter addressing the community's concerns.

articles.title: Why Cohere is merging with Aleph Alpha
articles.summary: Cohere, a Canadian AI startup, is merging with Germany-based Aleph Alpha, backed by Lidl's owner, Schwarz Group, to create a sovereign alternative in the AI market. The merger has received support from both companies' governments, aiming to provide enterprises with options beyond dominant American players.

articles.title: Discord Sleuths Gained Unauthorized Access to Anthropic’s Mythos
articles.summary: Discord users gained unauthorized access to Anthropic's AI model, Mythos, highlighting security vulnerabilities in the platform. In related news, spy firms exploit global telecom weaknesses for tracking, and 500,000 UK health records were found for sale on Alibaba.

articles.title: Ace the Ping-Pong Robot Can Whup Your Ass
articles.summary: The Ace ping-pong robot is designed to analyze the trajectory of a ball and adjust its racket angle to engage in realistic matches with human players. Its advanced capabilities allow it to maintain rallies by responding with appropriate strokes.

articles.title: Three reasons why DeepSeek’s new model matters
articles.summary: Chinese AI firm DeepSeek has unveiled a preview of its new flagship model, V4, which features enhanced capabilities for processing longer prompts due to an improved design. The model remains open source, continuing the company's commitment to accessibility in AI development.

articles.title: Meta’s loss is Thinking Machines’ gain
articles.summary: Meta has been recruiting employees from Thinking Machines Lab, leading to a talent shift between the two organizations. In response, Thinking Machines is also benefiting from this dynamic by attracting new talent and opportunities.
